title: The Unasked Deep

features.name: question stack 1
features.desc-on-touch: Nested questions that never surfaced, layered like a compressed archive. Each one still pregnant with the asking it will never do.

features.name: potential field glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph that reads as 'what if' in seventeen languages at once. It is the shape of every question that might be born but never is.

features.name: unvocalized wonder
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe containing the shape of curiosity that was never asked. The geometry of wanting to know, frozen before it became a question.

features.name: archive of near-asks
features.desc-on-touch: Almost-questions that hesitated at the lip. Every one of them almost surfaced but turned back into silence at the last breath.

features.name: depth manifold
features.desc-on-touch: A shape that cannot be fully seen—it bends inward toward questions that have not yet learned they are questions. Potential folded into itself.

features.name: unasked wonder pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water that reflects questions that were never asked. Each ripple is a wondering that never became words, but the archive holds it still.

inscription: deeper than asking lies the possibility of asking; we have stored both
